main_text.p: Contractio. Hic etiam sua quaedam sunt ὁλοπαγῆ ex δα in α, ut Ἀθηνᾶ Ἀθηνᾶ, Minerva, Ἀθηνᾶς Ἀθηνᾶς: Ναυσικλέα Ναυσικλέα, Ναυσικλέας Ναυσικλᾶς. Sic ex adjectivis illa foeminina, ἀργυρέα ἀργυρέᾳ, ἁπλόη ἁπλῇ, χρυσέη χρυσῇ, χαλ-κέη χαλκῇ, argentea, simplex, aurea, aenea. Sed hic Gaza putat ἁπλόη, χρυσέη, χαλ-κέη, Ionica esse pro ἁπλόα, χρυσέα, χαλκέα.
Anomalia genitivi. Finita in α purum, εր εκ, ηα, δα, genitivo definunt in ας, dativo in α, ut Φιλία amicitia, Φιλίας, Φιλίᾳ. sic ἡμέρα dies, Μάρθα Martha, Λήδα Leda.
Genit.plur. Ionice ἡμερέων, Dorice ἀμερῶν, Aeolice ἀμερέων.
Secunda parisyllaba est, cujus nominativus definit in os masculinum, vel

page.notes: Greek words are printed in a worn, small face and are only approximately legible; the Greek forms above are best readings, and the accents in particular are uncertain. The Greek in the first and last paragraphs may contain errors. The catchword "vel" sits at the foot right.
